Title: How does Aisata Swanou´s special work?

Messages.Author: Ashur
Messages.Body:
How does Aisata Swanou´s special work?

Card text:
During your master phase, you may draw a card and move a card from your hand to either your ash heap or the top of your library.

Does this mean you do all of the following:
1. Draw a card
2. Adjust hand size
3. Move a card from your hand to ash heap or top of library
4. Adjust hand size

Seems a bit strong *hrm* I mean nice

Full card text:  www.secretlibrary.info/index.php?crypt=1291

"My strategy? Luck is my strategy, of course."

> Ashur wrote:
> Thanks Pascal. That was actually what I thought  But do you think this is a good wording? ((You are always supposed to replace carde _immediatelly_, right?)
>
It uses a very similar template to Heart of Cheating, which seems to have been used by most people in this way since Third Edition.

Heart of Nizchetus
Unique equipment.
During your untap phase, if the bearer is ready, you may draw up to three cards from your library and then move the same number of cards from your hand to the bottom of your library.
